help.heading: Indlela yokusebenzisa isibali seresiphi
help.intro: Isibali siguqula iresiphi ye-glaze, izisindo zokokwakha oxubayo, sibe yi-UMF (unity molecular formula) yayo: ama-oxide i-glaze eba yiwo ku-kiln (isithando sokushisa izitsha zobumba), alinganiswe ukuze ama-flux ahlangane abe ngu-1. Iyazibuyekeza njengoba uthayipha.

name.heading: Qamba iresiphi
name.text: Yinike isihloko. Usuku namanothi kungokuzikhethela; amanothi ayindawo enhle ye-cone, umoya we-kiln nokuthi ukuhlola kuphume kanjani.

materials.heading: Engeza okokwakha
materials.text: Ngaphansi kokuthi Engeza okokwakha, khetha Okokwakha kwami (lokho okufake ku-khasi lokokwakha, njengokuhlaziya kwakho i-feldspar) noma Okujwayelekile (uhlu olwakhelwe ngaphakathi). Thayipha ingxenye yegama esihlungini ukuze unciphise uhlu olude, bese uchofoza okokwakha ukuze ukwengeze. Ikhesa iya enanini lakho.

amounts.heading: Faka amanani
amounts.text: Sebenzisa noma iyiphi iyunithi: iphesenti, izingxenye noma amagremu. Kuphela izilinganiso ezibalulekile kukhemistri. Ikholomu yesabelo ibonisa iphesenti lokokwakha ngakunye ku-batch, futhi isamba singaphansi kohlu.

unity.heading: Funda i-UMF
unity.text: Ihlala eceleni kweresiphi (ngaphansi kwayo efonini) futhi iyashintsha ngenani ngalinye olithayiphayo:
unity.fluxes: Ama-flux (R₂O ne-RO) ahlangana abe ngu-1.000; enza i-glaze incibilike.
unity.stabilizers: Iziqinisi (R₂O₃), ikakhulukazi i-alumina, ziqinisa okuncibilikile ukuze kuhlale embizeni.
unity.ratio: Isilinganiso se-silica ne-alumina sikhomba ubuso: izilinganiso eziphezulu zivame ukucwebezela kakhulu, eziphansi zingacwebezeli kakhulu, nakuba ama-flux nokushisa nakho kubalulekile.
unity.problems: Uma okokwakha kungaziwa, inani lingeyona inombolo, noma kungekho lutho kuresiphi oluyi-flux, kuyakusho.

additives.heading: Engeza okokufaka umbala nezithasiselo
additives.text: Lokhu kungena ngaphezu kwesisekelo. Kulondolozwa neresiphi kodwa akuyona ingxenye ye-UMF. Khetha ukuthi inani ngalinye likuyiphi iyunithi:
additives.percent: % yesisekelo: iphesenti lesamba sesisekelo, njengoba amaresiphi amaningi ekunikeza: u-2 usho u-2% we-red iron oxide.
additives.parts: izingxenye: iyunithi efanayo neyokokwakha, njengengxenye engu-1 esisekelweni se-flint engu-3 ne-dolomite engu-2.
additives.count: Ezinye izibali zibala okokufaka umbala ku-UMF kanti ezinye azikubali. Khetha okuthi Bala okokufaka umbala nezithasiselo kuyo, ngaphansi kwesihloko se-UMF, ukuze ukubale ngesisindo sakho ku-batch, noma ukushiye kungakhethiwe ukuze uqhathanise nesibali esingakubali. Ukukhetha kulondolozwa neresiphi.

scale.heading: Shintsha isikali lapho udinga
scale.parts: Ezingxenyeni: izinombolo eziphelele ezincane kakhulu ezifanelekayo, njenge-flint engu-3 ne-dolomite engu-2; okokwakha okungahlukaniseki ngokulinganayo kugcina inani lakho eliqondile, njengo-1.477.
scale.batch: Lungisela i-batch: faka isisindo, njengo-500 g, ukuze uthole amagremu okufanele uwakale. Uma izisindo zingamaphawundi nama-ounce (ngaphansi kokuthi Izilungiselelo ekhasini le-akhawunti yakho), faka amaphawundi, njengo-12.5: amanani aba amaphawundi, ngalinye libonakala ngamaphawundi nama-ounce ngaphansi kwalo.
scale.text: Wonke amanani ashintsha ngesikhathi esisodwa, kufika ezindaweni zedesimali ezinhlanu, futhi i-UMF ihlala ifana. Okokufaka umbala okusezingxenyeni noma ngamagremu kushintsha nokokwakha; lokho okungu-% yesisekelo kuhlala kunjalo, ngoba iphesenti lesisekelo liyafana kunoma yisiphi isikali.

save.heading: Londoloza
save.save: Londoloza igcina iresiphi lapha futhi iyengeze ku-Amaresiphi ami alondoloziwe. Ukulondoloza futhi kubuyekeza leyo resiphi efanayo.
save.next: Londoloza bese wengeza iresiphi elandelayo iyalondoloza, bese isula ikhasi ukuze kube neresiphi elandelayo.
save.copy: Londoloza njengekhophi ilondoloza izinguquko zakho njengeresiphi entsha futhi ishiye eyokuqala injengoba ibinjalo: kuhle ekwenzeni okuhlukile kweresiphi.
save.open: Vula, ku-Amaresiphi ami alondoloziwe, ibuyisela iresiphi elondoloziwe lapha ukuze uyishintshe.

compare.heading: Qhathanisa amaresiphi amabili
compare.text: Qhathanisa, eceleni kokuthi Londoloza noma kuresiphi elondoloziwe, ibeka ama-UMF amabili eduze i-oxide ne-oxide, nomehluko kusukela kweyokuqala kuya kweyesibili. Ukuze uqhathanise okufanayo nokufanayo, bala okokufaka umbala kuzo zombili noma kungabi kuyo neyodwa.
compare.modern: Iresiphi esebenzisa okokwakha okungasenziwa, njenge-Custer Spar, ithi yini esetshenziswa manje, nokuthi kungathatha yini indawo yakho igremu ngegremu. Zama okokwakha kwanamuhla bese uqhathanisa ikushintshela ngaphakathi, kukodwa ngokukodwa, njengeresiphi entsha, bese iyiqhathanisa nendala; Hlehlisa ukushintsha iyakubuyisela. Lapho ukushintsha kungafani ncamashi, Phakamisa amanani bese uqhathanisa iphinda ibale amanani ukuze ibuyise i-UMF, ishintsha okumbalwa ngangokunokwenzeka. Uma okokwakha okusha kungakwazi ukubuyisa okuthile obekunikezwa okudala, njenge-potash ye-niter, kubuza ukuthi yini okufanele ikubuyise. Kufanisa ama-oxide ashisiwe kuphela, ngakho hlola i-batch encane kuqala.
compare.lead: Iresiphi enomthofu (lead, Pb) iyakusho. Thatha isikhundla somthofu ibuza i-cone oshisa kuyo nokuthi iyiphi i-frit engenamthofu ozokwakhela phezu kwayo, bese yakha kabusha i-glaze (i-silica ne-alumina yayo kugciniwe, i-boron namanye ama-flux enza umsebenzi womthofu) noma igcina okokufaka umbala kwayo esisekelweni esingenamthofu se-frit ne-kaolin, 85 kuya ku-15. Okokwakha okunomthofu kubhalwa ukuze kwengezwe kuphela uma umthofu uvuliwe ngaphansi kokuthi Izilungiselelo ekhasini le-akhawunti yakho.
compare.shelf: Yenza ngalokho enginakho yenza iresiphi futhi ngokokwakha onakho manje kuphela, isondele kuma-oxide ayo ashisiwe ngangokuvumela kwakho. Uhlu lwakho lokokwakha onakho lugcinwa ne-akhawunti yakho.
compare.tries: Ngamunye walokhu angathatha okokwakha ongakuzama, noma yikuphi onakho noma ongathanda kucatshangelwe, futhi ukhethe okuthi Kumele kusetshenziswe ukuze ugcine okuthile. Iresiphi entsha ithi okokwakha ngakunye kunikezani nokuthi ukufanisa kuyakudinga yini, yini enye engasiza, nokuthi yini okufanele uyiqaphele. Ngale komkhawulo onconywayo, njenge-boron eningi ku-cone 6 noma i-whiting eluhlaza ku-cone 04, ithi i-glaze cishe izokwenzani esikhundleni sokwenqaba. Izinkinobho zayo ziphinda zibale iresiphi kusukela kwendala: shiya okokwakha ngaphandle, wengeze okuthile, noma uvumele okuningi ngale komkhawulo.

numbers.heading: Funda ukuhlaziywa nemikhawulo
numbers.analysis: Ukuhlaziywa nemikhawulo, ngaphansi kweresiphi, kubonisa ama-mole e-oxide ngayinye, i-mole % ne-% yesisindo eshisiwe, i-loss on ignition kanye nokunwebeka kokushisa okubaliwe, okuyisilinganiso sokuqhathanisa ama-glaze.
numbers.limits: Imikhawulo ibeka i-UMF eceleni kweqoqo lemikhawulo: imikhawulo yama-glaze azinzile ka-Hesselberth & Roy ngaphandle uma ukhetha eye-Glazecalc uqobo (ukukhetha kulondolozwa nezilungiselelo zakho). Ihlola ibhendi yokushisa enikezwa ngu-Ukushisa kweresiphi: i-cone yayo, noma ibanga layo. Ibanga elidlula amabhendi, njenge-cone 6 kuya ku-10, libonisa ukuhlolwa kwawo womabili amabhendi eceleni. Ukuze uhlole ibhendi eyodwa kuphela, yikhethe ebhokisini le-Ukushisa lemikhawulo uqobo, elidlula ukushisa kweresiphi futhi lilondolozwe neresiphi. Izibalo zika-Hesselberth & Roy zezama-cone 6 no-10, ngakho ekushiseni okuphansi ithi azisebenzi. Ziyiziqondiso, hhayi ukuphumelela noma ukwehluleka. Phezulu, umugqa owodwa uqhathanisa i-boron, i-silica ne-alumina ye-glaze nokushisa kwayo, ngomthetho ka-Katz we-boron nezibalo zika-Hesselberth & Roy noma ngabe yiliphi iqoqo lemikhawulo olikhethayo: unikeza inothi kuphela uma kuvumelana ukuthi i-glaze ibukeka sengathi ingeyokushisa okuhlukile, uthi uma ungakwazi ukwahlulela (umthofu, i-lithium, i-raku nokunjalo), futhi uwumhlahlandlela, hhayi ukuhlolwa.
numbers.stull: Ishadi le-Stull libeka i-silica ye-glaze ngokumelene ne-alumina yayo, nezifunda ze-Stull ezingacwebezeli, ezingacwebezeli kancane nezikhanyayo kanye namabanga eqoqo lemikhawulo. Liwumhlahlandlela wobuso, hhayi ukubikezela.
numbers.slurry: I-specific gravity namanzi isebenzisa ifomula ka-Brongniart: kala ivolumu elinganisiwe ye-glaze, bese ubona i-glaze eyomile ebhakedeni, amanzi ayilethayo ku-SG oyifunayo, noma amanzi e-batch entsha. Ukuminyana kulandela isilungiselelo sakho se-specific gravity, i-Baumé noma isisindo se-pint.

print.heading: Yiphrintele igumbi le-glaze
print.text: Phrinta, eceleni kokuthi Londoloza noma kuresiphi elondoloziwe, iyibeka ukuze iphrintwe ephepheni. Phrinta iresiphi yonke ne-UMF yayo nokuhlaziywa, noma uhlu lwe-batch kuphela: okufanele ukukale ku-batch yanoma yibuphi ubukhulu, isamba esiqhubekayo sokukala ebhakedeni elilodwa, namabhokisi okumaka. Izisindo zingamagremu, kufika kweyeshumi noma ngokuphelele, noma ngamaphawundi nama-ounce: khetha ngaphansi kokuthi Izilungiselelo ekhasini le-akhawunti yakho.

help.tips: Amathiphu: okokwakha okungekho ohlwini olujwayelekile kungengezwa ku-khasi lokokwakha kusuka kufomula yakho yekhemikhali noma ekuhlaziyweni komhlinzeki. Futhi hlola ngaphambi kokuthemba: izinombolo zibonisa ukuthambekela, hhayi lokho i-kiln yakho ezokwenza.

checks.boronMidFireSet: Le yi-boron eningi ku-cone 6 ({boron}; leli qoqo lemikhawulo libala u-{high} njengophezulu).
checks.boronHighFire: Le yi-boron eningi ku-cone 10 ({boron}; leli qoqo lemikhawulo libala u-{high} njengophezulu).
checks.boronMidFireProbably: Ama-glaze anjengale cishe azogeleza, abe njengobisi noma abe nemigqa, futhi angaba ne-crazing noma angaguguli kahle.
checks.boronMidFireTends: Ama-glaze anjengale avame ukugeleza, abe njengobisi noma abe nemigqa, futhi angaba ne-crazing noma angaguguli kahle.
checks.boronMidFireFix: Sebenzisa i-boron eyanele nje ukuncibilikisa; i-kaolin ne-silica kuyayizinzisa.
checks.boronShort: Lokhu kune-boron encane ({boron}) kunaleyo ama-glaze avame ukuyidinga kulokhu kushisa (cishe u-{needed}).
checks.boronShortEffects: Ingase ingancibiliki ngokuphelele, iphume iqinile, yomile noma inezimbobo ezincane. Yihlole; uma ingashiswanga ngokwanele, ukushisa okushisa kakhulu noma i-frit yesisekelo encane eyengeziwe kuyasiza.
checks.aluminaLowProbably: Cishe izoba yi-glaze ecwebezelayo egelezayo, engakha amakristalu noma ibe namafu njengoba iphola, futhi ithambile ingaqinile kangako.
checks.aluminaLowTends: Ivame ukuba yi-glaze ecwebezelayo egelezayo, engakha amakristalu noma ibe namafu njengoba iphola, futhi ithambile ingaqinile kangako.
checks.aluminaLowFix: I-kaolin eningi, noma i-frit ene-alumina eningi, ivame ukukulungisa.
checks.aluminaHighEffects: Ingase ingancibiliki ngokuphelele futhi ingaphuma yomile noma ingacwebezeli, inezimbobo ezincane noma izindawo ezingenalutho.
checks.aluminaHighLowFire: Ku-cone 06-02 i-glaze engacwebezeli enjena ivame ukungancibiliki ngokwanele, ngakho yihlole ngaphambi kokuyisebenzisela ukudla.
checks.aluminaHighFix: I-flux eningi noma i-kaolin encane ibuyisa ukucwebezela.
checks.boronBlue: I-calcium eningi ne-boron eningi kuvame ukuba mhlophe njengobisi ngokuluhlaza lapho i-glaze iqoqana khona ("boron blue").
checks.boronBlueFixPink: I-kaolin eningi noma ukupholisa ngokushesha kuvame ukukususa.
checks.boronBlueFix: I-calcium encane, i-kaolin eningi noma ukupholisa ngokushesha kuvame ukukususa.
checks.alkali: Lokhu kune-soda ne-potash eningi ({alkali}). Imibala izokhanya (i-copper iba yi-turquoise).
checks.alkaliProbably: Kodwa cishe izoba ne-crazing, kwesinye isikhathi emasontweni kamuva, futhi inobuso obuthambile obungakhipha izinsimbi (leach): ilungele izinto zokuhlobisa, hhayi izindawo zokudla.
checks.alkaliTends: Kodwa ivame ukuba ne-crazing, kwesinye isikhathi emasontweni kamuva, futhi inobuso obuthambile obungakhipha izinsimbi (leach): ilungele izinto zokuhlobisa, hhayi izindawo zokudla.
checks.alkaliFix: Ukushintsha enye yayo ngokuthi i-calcium, i-magnesium, i-boron noma i-lithium kunciphisa i-crazing.
checks.magnesiaProbably: Cishe izokwenza i-glaze iqine kakhulu, ingacwebezeli futhi ingabonakali ngaphakathi, futhi ingayenza ihoxe (crawl).
checks.magnesiaTends: Ivame ukwenza i-glaze iqine kakhulu, ingacwebezeli futhi ingabonakali ngaphakathi, futhi ingayenza ihoxe (crawl).
checks.magnesiaNote: Ifiphaza ophinki be-chrome-tin, nakuba isiza ngempela ukuvimba i-crazing.
checks.zincChrome: I-zinc yenza okuluhlaza kwe-chrome kube nsundu futhi yonakalisa ophinki be-chrome-tin; i-Mason ithi akukho zinc nalawa ma-stain. Shiya i-zinc ngaphandle, noma usebenzise i-stain eyenzelwe ama-glaze ane-zinc.
checks.zincIron: I-zinc ingafiphaza imibala ye-iron. Ukuze uthole i-amber ehlanzekile nonsundu bezinyosi, hlola inguqulo engenayo i-zinc.
checks.zincCopper: I-zinc ishintsha umbala we-copper, ngokuvamile ube luhlaza okwesibhakabhaka kakhulu noma ukhanye kakhulu kunokuba luhlaza. Hlola ngaphambi kokuthembela kukho.
checks.zincLowFire: Ngaphansi kwecishe i-cone 03, i-zinc ({zinc}) yenza ukuncibilikisa okuncane. Ingahoxa (crawl) noma ibe nezimbobo ezincane futhi inikeze ubuso obungacwebezeli noma obunamakristalu; i-zinc e-calcined ihoxa kancane.
checks.whiting: I-whiting cishe ayincibiliki ku-cone 06-04 futhi ikhipha igesi njengoba ihlakazeka.
checks.whitingProbably: Ku-{percent}% cishe izoba nezimbobo ezincane noma amabhamuza futhi iphume yomile, ingacwebezeli noma injengochoko.
checks.whitingTends: Ku-{percent}% ivame ukuba nezimbobo ezincane noma amabhamuza futhi iphume yomile, ingacwebezeli noma injengochoko.
checks.whitingFix: I-calcium evela ku-frit noma ku-wollastonite igwema kokubili. (U-5% yisiqondiso sale app; awukho umkhawulo oshicilelwe owunikezayo.)
checks.fluorine: Okokwakha {name} kukhipha i-fluorine njengoba kushiswa. Khipha umoya ku-kiln kahle, noma usebenzise okokwakha okungenayo i-fluorine esikhundleni sakho.
checks.clayLowWas: Lokhu kunobumba oluluhlaza olungu-{clay}% kuphela; iresiphi endala ibinolungu-{was}%.
checks.clayNoneWas: Lokhu akunabumba oluluhlaza; iresiphi endala ibinolungu-{was}%.
checks.clayLowFix: Ngaphandle kobumba i-glaze izika iqine ebhakedeni futhi iwe njengothuli embizeni ngaphambi kokushiswa. Engeza u-1-2% we-bentonite ukuze uyigcine intanta, noma ugcine obunye ubumba bese wamukela ukufanisa okwehluke kancane.
checks.clayHigh: Ubumba oluluhlaza olungaphezu kuka-20% ({clay}%) luncipha kakhulu njengoba i-glaze yoma.
checks.clayHighProbably: Cishe izoqhekeka embizeni futhi ihoxe (crawl) ibe yizindawo ezingenalutho ku-kiln.
checks.clayHighTends: Ivame ukuqhekeka embizeni futhi ihoxe (crawl) ibe yizindawo ezingenalutho ku-kiln.
checks.clayHighFix: Shintsha ingxenye yalo ngokuthi i-kaolin e-calcined (cishe u-12% ngaphansi ngesisindo), ugcine cishe u-15-20% oluhlaza ukuze i-glaze ihlale intanta.
checks.soluble: Okokwakha {name} kuyancibilika emanzini, okukwenza kube okokwakha kwe-glaze okungekuhle: kungena embizeni futhi kuyashintsha njengoba i-glaze imile. Ama-frit aphatha ama-oxide afanayo ngaphandle kokuncibilika.
checks.boronFrit: I-frit ye-calcium borate ngokuvamile iyisengezo esincane se-boron, hhayi isisekelo (omunye umthengisi uthi okungeqile ku-10%). Njenge-frit eyinhloko, lindela i-glaze egelezayo engaba njengobisi noma mhlophe ngokuluhlaza futhi ikhule amakristalu ebhakedeni. Sebenzisa i-frit yesisekelo ye-borosilicate futhi le uyigcine incane.
checks.lowExpansionFrit: Ama-frit anokunwebeka okuphansi ayamelapha i-crazing, asetshenziswa cishe ku-5-10%. Njenge-frit eyinhloko i-glaze ingase ingancibiliki ngokuphelele ku-cone 06-02 futhi ingabukeka ingacwebezeli; lapho incibilika khona, ingaba ne-shivering, ikhiphe amazengezi abukhali emaphethelweni.
checks.alkaliFrit: I-frit ene-alkali ephezulu njenge-flux eyinhloko inikeza umbala okhanyayo kodwa i-glaze ethambile, egelezayo eba ne-crazing cishe kunoma yibuphi ubumba: ilungele i-crackle ne-raku, hhayi izindawo zokudla.

limits.heading: Imikhawulo

notes.hesselberth-roy: Imikhawulo enconywa ngu-John Hesselberth no-Ron Roy yama-glaze azinzile phezu kwe-stoneware ne-porcelain yokusetshenziswa, ku-cone 6 nase-cone 10. Banamathela ohlwini olufushane lokokwakha, ngakho iqoqo alinalo ibanga le-barium noma le-lithium, noma le-zinc ku-cone 10.
notes.glazecalc: Izibalo i-app exwayisa ngazo lapho ishintsha okokwakha: i-boron, i-alumina, i-soda ne-potash, ne-magnesia ekushiseni okuphansi.

worked.heading: Ukuthi i-UMF ibalwa kanjani
worked.intro: I-UMF (ifomula ye-Seger) inikeza i-glaze njengama-mole e-oxide ngayinye, alinganiswe ukuze ama-flux ayo ahlangane abe ngu-1. Nazi izinyathelo, nezinombolo zale resiphi; i-Glazecalc ibala eyayo ngendlela efanayo.
worked.gramsText: Funda inani ngalinye njengamagremu okokwakha. Noma ibuphi ubukhulu be-batch bunikeza i-UMF efanayo, ngoba yonke inombolo ihlukaniswa ngesamba sama-flux ekugcineni.
worked.molesHeading: Thola ama-mole e-oxide ngayinye kokokwakha ngakunye
worked.molesText: Ukuhlaziywa kokokwakha kunikeza iphesenti le-oxide ngayinye okulishiyayo ngemva kokushiswa. Amagremu akho × lelo phesenti ÷ 100 angamagremu e-oxide, futhi lawo magremu ÷ i-molar mass ye-oxide (amagremu ku-mole eyodwa yayo) angama-mole ayo.
worked.loi: I-loss on ignition {loi}%: amanzi ne-carbon dioxide okushayo kushiye kungekho oxide.
worked.totalsText: Hlanganisa ama-mole e-oxide ngayinye avela kukho konke okokwakha. Ama-flux, ancibilikisa ingilazi, angama-oxide e-R₂O ne-RO, njenge-soda, i-potash, i-lime ne-magnesia.
worked.divideText: Hlukanisa ama-mole e-oxide ngayinye ngo-{total}, isamba sama-flux. Bese ama-flux ehlangana abe ngu-1, futhi enye i-oxide ngayinye isesemi-mole nge-mole ngayinye ye-flux.
worked.answerText: Izinombolo ezifanayo njengoba ababumbi bezifunda: ama-flux, iziqinisi nabakhi bengilazi, nesilinganiso se-silica ne-alumina.
worked.rounding: Izinombolo ziyajikelezwa ukuze ziboniswe, kodwa isinyathelo ngasinye sizisebenzisa zingajikelezwanga, ngakho ukuhlanganisa izibalo ezijikelezwe kungahluka endaweni yokugcina.
